title: Street Sketch Graffiti Icons Vector Symb
author: sipanji figuree
description:
Street Sketch Graffiti Icons Vector Symbol Set is a creative collection of 20 hand-drawn urban doodle symbols designed with rough sketch textures, graffiti-inspired line art, and expressive underground street aesthetics. Featuring energetic marker-style strokes combined with playful sketch elements, this vector icon set delivers an authentic modern street art vibe perfect for trendy visual projects and youth-inspired branding.
Inside this pack you’ll find a variety of iconic urban illustrations including dripping hearts, stars, flames, lightning symbols, speech bubbles, smiling faces, vintage cameras, crowns, skull graphics, arrows, spray paint cans, bombs, clouds, eye symbols, broken hearts, lock icons, peace gestures, sparkle effects, and music notes. Every design is illustrated with dynamic hand-sketched details to create a bold and artistic graffiti notebook appearance.
These vector graphics are ideal for sticker packs, apparel branding, skate culture artwork, poster layouts, social media graphics, gaming visuals, YouTube content, album covers, print-on-demand products, urban merchandise, scrapbook projects, and creative DIY crafts. The sketch graffiti style adds raw visual energy and modern underground aesthetics to any design concept.
Fully editable vector files allow easy customization for color palettes, outlines, scaling, layouts, and compositions without losing quality. Compatible with Adobe Illustrator, Canva, Cricut Design Space, Affinity Designer, CorelDRAW, and other vector editing software, this icon set is suitable for both professional designers and beginner creators.
Inspired by street sketchbooks, graffiti doodles, urban marker art, punk-inspired visuals, and contemporary youth culture, these icons combine messy hand-drawn textures with stylish urban simplicity. The bold black line artwork and expressive sketch effects help create eye-catching designs with authentic street character.
Included file formats: SVG and EPS editable vector files.
